recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF).
2. Place a text box in the top-left title region (approx 5-30% x, 5-15% y) with the exact text "At Hidden Layer"; format as bold, red (#FF0000), underlined, sans-serif.
3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle in the top-right slide-number region (approx 90-95% x, 8-15% y) and center the black (#000000) sans-serif text "21" inside it.
4. Draw a rectangle with a red (#FF0000) border and no fill in the main-diagram-container region (approx 5-95% x, 18-75% y).
5. Inside the container, draw three blue (#0000FF) circles vertically along the left side of the neural-network region (approx 15-25% x, 22-55% y); label each circle "O_i" in blue (#0000FF) sans-serif.
6. Draw one circle in the center of the neural-network region (approx 45-55% x, 35-45% y) with a red (#FF0000) outline and green (#008000) fill; label it "δ_j" in red (#FF0000) sans-serif.
7. Draw three orange (#FFA500) circles vertically along the right side of the neural-network region (approx 75-85% x, 22-55% y); label each circle "δ_k" in orange (#FFA500) sans-serif.
8. Draw arrows from each of the three left blue circles to the center circle; label each arrow "w_ji" in black (#000000) sans-serif.
9. Draw arrows from the center circle to each of the three right orange circles; label each arrow "w_kj" in black (#000000) sans-serif.
10. Draw an upward-pointing arrow below the center circle (approx 45-55% x, 50-55% y) and label it "j" in black (#000000) sans-serif.
11. Inside the large container, place a light-green (#90EE90) rectangular box in the green-equation-box region (approx 8-92% x, 58-72% y).
12. Inside the green box, typeset the equation "Δ_ji = η O_i O_j(1-O_j) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]" with these exact colored terms: "Δ_ji" in black (#000000), "η" in red (#FF0000), "O_i" in blue (#0000FF), "O_j(1-O_j)" in green (#008000), and "[Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]" in red (#FF0000).
13. Draw a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a red (#FF0000) border in the bottom-equation-box region (approx 5-95% x, 78-95% y).
14. Inside the bottom box, typeset the simplified equation "Δ_ji = η O_i δ_j" with these exact colored terms: "Δ_ji" in black (#000000), "η" in red (#FF0000), "O_i" in blue (#0000FF), and "δ_j" in red (#FF0000).
15. Below that equation, add the label "Where:" in black (#000000) sans-serif.
16. Below "Where:", typeset the equation "δ_j = O_j(1-O_j) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]" with these exact colored terms: "δ_j" in red (#FF0000), "O_j(1-O_j)" in green (#008000), and "[Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]" in red (#FF0000).
